value.answer: This week, focus on learning Docker. Spend about 2 hours on Docker's Get Started guide to understand images, containers, and volumes. Then, spend 2 hours running, inspecting, and stopping three containers from Docker Hub to practice. Finally, spend 4 hours containerising the captioning API with Docker in your pod project. Your proof of skill will be merging a pull request that adds a Dockerfile to your pod repo. This hands-on work will build your Docker skills, important for many ML engineer jobs.
